title: Define third-party MCP server fixture selection policy
summary: Before adding an opt-in third-party MCP server fixture, define the selection policy (provenance pinning, license check, opt-in default-off semantics, reproducible build evidence) as a docs+validator contract. Avoids landing a fixture that quietly imports an unvetted dependency surface.
expectedFailureModes: A third-party MCP fixture lands without a documented selection policy and pulls in an unvetted dependency surface.
Selection policy exists in prose but has no validator hook, so a future deletion of required fields slips through review.
docs/status.md is updated to imply an opt-in fixture is available before the policy itself is reviewed.
humanEscalation: Final fixture selection, vendor allowlist, and any external network access remain human-owned.
nextAction: Document the third-party MCP fixture selection policy in docs/mcp-tools.md (or a sibling page), add a validator that scans the policy fields for completeness, and link from docs/status.md MCP tools row without claiming a fixture is shipping.
